GainUnit.description:
A finite source→target scaling descriptor for condition-table gain columns.

A gain coefficient is not an independently editable unit on every function.
The tagged descriptor avoids arbitrary expression strings such as mm/(px*s).
GainUnit.title: GainUnit

SparseNoiseSettings.description:
Seeded patterns generated during playback; no image assets (V04).

Compilation resolves the complete-cell grid from the display and replaces width
and height with its physical extent.
